packages.description: All National Parks managed by the National Park Service.
packages.author: Journey
packages.journeyDescription: Explore all 63 congressionally designated national parks across the United States and its territories, from iconic mountain and desert landscapes to tropical reefs, ancient forests, caves, and remote Arctic wilderness.

packages.description: Explore Wisconsin's state parks, forests, and recreation areas.
packages.author: Journey
packages.journeyDescription: Explore 50 remarkable state parks and recreation areas across Wisconsin, from Great Lakes shorelines and Northwoods waterfalls to Driftless bluffs and glacial landscapes.

packages.description: All active home stadiums used by National Football League teams in the United States.
packages.author: Journey
packages.journeyDescription: Visit the 30 active stadiums used by all 32 NFL teams, from historic venues such as Lambeau Field and Soldier Field to modern landmarks including SoFi Stadium, Allegiant Stadium, and Buffalo's new Highmark Stadium.

packages.description: Visit every active Major League Baseball home stadium across the United States and Canada.
packages.author: Journey
packages.journeyDescription: Visit all 30 active Major League Baseball home stadiums across the United States and Canada, from historic Fenway Park and Wrigley Field to waterfront favorites, retractable-roof venues, and the Athletics' temporary home in West Sacramento.

packages.description: Visit every active National Hockey League home arena across the United States and Canada.
packages.author: Journey
packages.journeyDescription: Visit all 32 active National Hockey League home arenas across the United States and Canada, from historic hockey landmarks to modern downtown venues and the new home of the Utah Mammoth.

packages.description: Visit every active National Basketball Association home arena across the United States and Canada.
packages.author: Journey
packages.journeyDescription: Visit all 30 active National Basketball Association home arenas across the United States and Canada, from historic Madison Square Garden and TD Garden to modern landmarks such as Chase Center and Intuit Dome.
